name: Open Items
rows: DRAFT FOR THE CPA · audit procedures · not an audit report · no opinion expressed

Kestrel Point Hotel Partners confirmed $510,000.00 against the books’ $538,600.00. HGC agreed in writing on June 18, 2026 to credit $28,600.00 for damaged corridor finishes and issued credit memo CM-0627 on July 8, recording it in July. At June 30 revenue and contract receivables are overstated by $28,600.00. Proposed: debit contract revenue, credit 1200, $28,600.00. 8.4% of materiality: passed if the client declines. The machine never posts.

Brindlewood School District No. 14 confirmed $371,250.00 of the $412,500.00 retainage release and paid that on August 19, 2026. It withholds $41,250.00 as liquidated damages, 15 days at $2,750.00, under section 8.3. HGC asked on July 20 for a 12-day extension for the district’s own delay and has no answer. The CPA reads the contract, the schedule and the extension request and decides whether the amount is collectible or reduces revenue.

Corliss Medical Group owes $186,935.00 on a final billing of January 22, 2026, more than 90 days past due at June 30. It did not reply to the confirmation or the second request, paid nothing through August 31, disputes the change order work and has not answered HGC’s letters; HGC filed a lien on February 27. No allowance is recorded. The CPA decides the allowance, up to the full balance.

Juniper Ridge Partners LLC, a commercial developer under the same owners, confirmed the $277,875.00 it owes for the J-2625 flex units and $14,625.00 of retainage. An affiliate’s reply is not independent evidence; the receipt of July 20 corroborates it. The CPA decides the related party disclosure.
Materiality is proposed at $340,000.00, 0.5% of the year’s revenue, with performance materiality $255,000.00 and clearly trivial $17,000.00. The engagement partner sets the final amounts.
No management representation letter has been obtained. It should cover the receivables, the credits agreed before the year end and the disputes.
These are draft workpapers and a draft findings memo for the engagement partner. They are not an audit report and give no opinion. Nothing has been signed, posted or sent.
